clips.title: The story
paras: Thelsamar's leaders seek Chok'sul's death to protect northeastern Loch Modan. Magistrate Bluntnose believes the ogre warlord directs attacks on local settlements and vital works, and offers a handsome reward for his head.

Organized ogres now threaten northeastern Loch Modan. Troggs and wild beasts have long tested the valley's borders, but these raiders bring a new danger the dwarven mountaineers cannot ignore. They have made camps in the rugged hills and moved beyond simple scavenging. Local scouts and town authorities report raids that are focused, persistent, and dangerous.

Magistrate Bluntnose believes Chok'sul directs attacks on Thelsamar, a nearby dwarven excavation site, and the Stonewrought Dam. The magistrate fears for civilian lives and the valley's great engineering work, so a bounty calls for the ogre chieftain's death by any means. His severed head is required as proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:
Chok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.
Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.
Chok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...
Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
